patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I have fought in a cage and broken my nose twice, but this pain brought me to my knees. It started in my left side and shoots toward my groin. I cannot stay still.
presentation.triageNote: 34-year-old man with abrupt severe left flank pain radiating toward the groin. He is visibly distressed and unable to remain still, rates the pain 10 of 10, and has no fever or hypotension.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because current ESI guidance specifically treats severe flank pain as a level-2 presentation requiring rapid assessment and symptom relief.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has severe flank pain with marked distress and requires prompt evaluation and pain control despite otherwise stable vital signs.
clinical.acuityReason: Abrupt 10-out-of-10 flank pain radiating to the groin with inability to remain still requires rapid assessment and symptom relief. The absence of fever or hypotension is reassuring but does not make the severe distress safe to delay.
keyFindings: Visible distress with inability to remain still
redFlags: Severe flank pain with marked distress
teachingPoints: Severe flank pain with marked distress requires rapid care and effective pain control.
Stable blood pressure and absence of fever help frame the differential but do not override the severity of the current symptoms.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would receive prompt analgesia, urinalysis, renal-function testing, and imaging as indicated, with discharge possible after pain control if no infection, renal impairment, or high-risk obstruction is identified.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 34-year-old fit man in a gym tank top
aiImageGeneration.pose: half off the chair, unable to find any comfortable position, clutching his left flank
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 34-year-old fit man in a gym tank top, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: half off the chair, unable to find a comfortable position, clutching his left flank, mid-writhe. Expression: grimacing, restless, shifting. Clearly visible: hand clutching the left flank, a body that can't hold still. Overall dramatic pain but vitally stable. No text, no logos.
